kindLab: Engine lesson kind: lab (run it for real)
kindPredict: Engine lesson kind: predict (aim a guess, then see the real plan)
kindCapstone: Engine lesson kind: capstone (the level's finish line)
docsOnly: Engine lesson read from the official docs (nothing runs here)
nosqlPath: Engine: the NoSQL path (MongoDB skills, like the SQL learning path)
engDesign: Engine: database design (a drafting compass, no logo; v24 L322)
engTimeseries: Engine: time-series (a sensor signal over time, no logo; v47 L970)
engOlap: Engine: OLAP and ClickHouse (a data cube, no logo; v47 L990)
engStack: Engine: the data stack (data flowing through a pipeline of stages, no logo; v45 L741)
engRedis: Engine: Redis, an in-memory key-value store (a memory chip, no logo; v47 L950)
skillMap: #/me skill map card (a grid of skill cells; v24 L323)
badgePart: badge: a learning-path Part held at Solid (a checked seal)
more: more menu (the plain dots-three duotone draws a pill inside the round button)
route: learning path / lanes: a route between two points
clockOff: nothing happened for a long time (quiet customers)
branch: CASE WHEN: one value, several branches
sigmaCheck: conditional aggregate: count only the checked rows
pattern: LIKE / pattern match (v42 L710: the plain magnifier went to search)
search: top-bar search: lessons and terms (v42 L710)
nested: scalar subquery: a query inside a query
nestedCheck: EXISTS: is there a match inside
window: window aggregate over a frame of rows
correlated: correlated subquery: the outer row goes in
crossJoin: CROSS JOIN: every row paired with every row, a grid (v25 R1)
anyAll: ANY / ALL: compare one value with every value of a list (v25 R1)
insertRows: INSERT: new rows added at the bottom of a table (v26 R2)
editRows: UPDATE / DELETE: rows edited or erased in place (v26 R2)
upsertMerge: ON CONFLICT / MERGE: insert or update, two paths into one row (v26 R2)
stepsMerge: several CTEs merge into one query
firstPerGroup: DISTINCT ON: the first row per group
inApp: advanced node practised here in the app (replaces the text mark of ui-ux-v6 S4)
partial: advanced node partly practised in the app
engine: Database Engine area (#/engine, L220): the storage under the database
image: download a dashboard card as a PNG picture (v16 L142)
secOpen: full lesson section 1, Opening: the lesson's goal (v24 R0, ux-route-v24 §12)
secSyntax: full lesson section 3, Syntax: the statement's frame
secRun: full lesson section 4, runnable examples: press to run
secPitfall: full lesson section 5, pitfalls: a hazard sign (not the banner's warning)
secPractice: full lesson section 6, Practice: write it yourself
secRecap: full lesson section 8, Recap: marked to remember
toc: a lesson's table of contents (In this lesson)
editTry: edit a read-only example in an editor (Try editing)
resetCode: put an edited example back as it was
notStarted: a skill or lesson not started yet: a ring not closed
run: run an example or a pitfall's query
